criterion: Every in-text citation has a matching bibliography entry
Every bib entry carries a doi or url and no duplicate keys
The cited source actually supports the claim
Staggered DiD uses a heterogeneity-robust estimator, not bare TWFE
Identification assumptions stated; testable ones tested
Random seeds fixed in simulation and resampling
Economic magnitude interpreted, not only stars
Proofs reported as needs-human-review, never as verified
Journal word limit / fee / acceptance rate come from the official page, not memory
Status wording is exactly one of the four verification states
Raw data is never read unless cleared in the safety sidecar
Drafts are never overwritten (versioned save path)
Package runs on the user OS (LF endings, names match, referenced files exist)
Figures use one consistent project theme
